headline: V. Krishnan files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: V. Krishnan has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE relating to substantial acquisition in Just Dial Limited. Filing confirms acquisition or proposed offer milestone under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a gating event-it marks the point at which an acquirer has crossed 25% threshold or proposes a general offer; subsequent open offer mechanics and regulatory timeline (20 trading days minimum for public shareholders) are now triggered.
detail: V. Krishnan has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations with the National Stock Exchange. The disclosure is the statutory notification required when a person acquires shares to the extent of 25% or more in a listed company, or proposes to make a general offer. The exact stake percentage, acquisition price, offer price (if any), and timeline for any subsequent open offer are contained in the filed disclosure document itself and not yet independently corroborated by public press release or regulator notice.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Central regulation governing substantial shareholding acquisitions, general offers, and mandatory public disclosure requirements.
Requires disclosure of substantial acquisition to stock exchange; triggers open offer obligation if stake crosses 25%.
Defines 'acquisition' and thresholds for disclosure (25%, 50%); applicability of general offer requirement.
Grants SEBI power to regulate takeovers and substantial acquisitions; provides statutory foundation for SAST Regulations.
Imposes continuing disclosure obligations on listed companies and acquirers; requires intimation of substantial shareholding changes within prescribed timelines.
Provides framework for members' meetings, voting rights, and acquisition-related shareholder approvals if applicable.
Continues disclosure and fair play requirements for public shareholders post-acquisition.

conditions: Acquirer stake crosses 25% or more in Just Dial Limited
approvals: Public shareholder participation (if open offer launched)

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
triggers.note: Disclosure trigger: acquirer must file with exchange within 4 trading days of acquisition crossing 25% threshold, or upon announcement of general offer.

triggers.law: SEBI Takeover Regulations, Regulation 10 & Schedule I
triggers.note: If stake ≥25%, general offer must be made to public shareholders at price at least equal to highest price paid in preceding 52 weeks.
Continuing disclosure, insider trading restrictions, and fair play requirements apply post-filing.
